question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at PQ as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a494301290148f8e6f52ea62f257c7895600bbe51266d9b8149890ac8b6f572.png]
solution:
Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a494301290148f8e6f52ea62f257c7895600bbe51266d9b8149890ac8b6f572.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f57f54347d994ffa4caa345a038b18414973b18286c74a8a6debbc37a3bab3a6.png] 

__Detailed Explanation:__

 
• The line PQ is the mirror.
 
• The given word *"CONTINUITY" ends with Y*. So the *mirror image will start with 'Y'** *⇒ Options 1 and 4 are eliminated. 
 
• The given word *"CONTINUITY"* has the sixth last letter "I", So the sixth letter of the mirror image should be "I" ⇒ Option 3 is eliminated.

Hence, **option (2) **is the correct answer.
